description: Type the 409 `domain-in-use` that deleteDomain (DELETE /v1/domains/{host}) gets while an app still routes the host. The spec documents it on that operation ("Refused with 409 `domain-in-use` while an app of the team still routes the name; remove those routes first"). It generated as the generic Conflict.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: An app of the team still routes this domain. Remove those routes with `patchRoutes`, then release the domain.
